name: Golden Valley Suite (Kim Cốc Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: while all three are worn, a debuff you applied that is cleansed returns a quarter of its remaining damage to the one who cleansed it.

story: Kim Cốc Viên's three treasures, split by its fall: the coin sold to the Từ house in 1004, the seal kept by the Quản as surety, the pearl lost in the ash. Quản Phục Thu wants all three, and Từ Bỉnh Quyền will not sell.

name: Vermilion and Azure (Đan Thanh Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Even Failures Are Pills (Bại Diệc Đan)
bonuses.rule: each pill you take in a fight lays two Fire stacks on the foe, and heals you 1 % for each Fire stack you hold on the foe; each pill after the third in a fight costs you 2 % of your health.

story: The two colours of his father's trade and the censer he made his name with. He calls it a joke; it is the only thing he owns that he will not sell.

name: Apricot Clinic (Hạnh Hoa Y Cụ)

bonuses.effect: Apricot Clinic's Spring (Hạnh Quán Hồi Xuân)
bonuses.rule: a poison or curse the Needles draw into you heals you over its duration instead of harming you, at half its strength.

story: Her old master Mẫn Tế Thế's needles, and the gourd and jade she added to them. Her heir Nhiêu Tử Uyển uses the needles when she is away, and gives them back.

name: The Losing Hand (Thua Thủ Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Lose to Win (Dĩ Thua Vi Thắng)
bonuses.rule: each crit that lands on you puts a coin in the vault, and the coins fall by one every 4 s; your next coin art spends them, gaining 10 % crit chance per coin and a buried ward worth 3 % of your health per coin.

story: Ring and robe of a man who bets badly on purpose, made for himself three centuries apart; he throws the Heaven-Minted Coin from inside them.

name: The Carried Array (Huề Trận Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Array Comes With Me (Trận Tùy Thân)
bonuses.rule: your diagram is open at fight start; while your array Field is up, each hit on you is answered once by your array's damage, at most once a second.

story: Seal, flag and shield of a runaway formation master: the seal he cut the year he left the abbey, the flag he copied from its pattern, the shield he bought with his first fee. Củng Tinh wants the flag back more than it wants him.

name: Fair Weights (Công Xứng Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each time a foe strikes you, it owes: your next hit on it deals extra damage equal to a fifth of what it dealt you (once every 2 s per foe).

story: The Từ house's ring and robe of office, which pass to its head. She wears them beside the Golden Valley coin, whose suite is not hers to complete.

name: The Bào Hull (Bào Gia Thuyền Cụ)

bonuses.effect: Ride Out the Storm (Đạp Phong Ba)
bonuses.rule: while you are Composed, each second you regain 2 % of your linh lực and gain one Water buff stack; each stack makes you take 1 % less damage, and the stacks fall away one a second once you are Pressing.

story: Anchor, armour and bell of the Bào ship-house, made from its first hull and its breakwater. They pass to the master of the house; his daughter would take them to sea with Diêm Hải Tảo.

name: Collected in Full (Thu Túc Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: a foe carrying 5 of your Earth stacks is collected: its stacks cannot be cleansed, and each second it loses 1 % of its health and you heal that much.

story: Her own pair: a coin from her first collection and the jade she bought back. The Golden Valley seal she holds as surety stays in its box: it is a pledge, not hers to wear.
